whenToUse: Cards with details below a summary, such as orders or notifications.
Showing more within a list without changing screens.
The expanded content differs in height from item to item.
whenNotToUse: The details are long enough to cover the screen (move to a detail screen).
Several must be compared at once (use a table).
The surrounding layout shakes a lot while expanding.

alternatives.name: Page Transition
alternatives.reason: The content is long enough to need a new screen.

accessibility: Put aria-expanded and aria-controls on the button to announce the expanded state.
Folded content is inert, so it's skipped by Tab and screen readers.
The expand arrow is decorative, so it's aria-hidden.
With reduced motion, height changes apply instantly.
